name: Point Query × Point Data, 3D Blur
definition: Computes in-scattered radiance at a query point x by searching for photon points stored within the medium, blurring values in three dimensions.
summary: Point Query × Point Data, 3D Blur estimates in-scattered radiance by summing contributions from photons within a fixed spherical kernel, distinguishing itself from the Extended Balance Heuristic through simple nearest-neighbor density estimation.
